capabilities: Render multiple vaults as an interactive force-directed graph with shared notes as intersection dots
Open a vault or a note (or the diff view) by clicking its line or dot
Diff and merge conflicting note versions side-by-side with per-line colour coding and editable cells
Filter and colour intersections with a query language (Meet, Merged, Diff functions)
Adjust display parameters, colour groups, and themes live
disambiguation: Not a sync tool; it visualizes and manually diffs/merges notes across vaults but never syncs them automatically.
extras: Desktop-only (Windows, macOS, Linux; Obsidian 1.7.2+); not yet listed in the community plugin directory, so manual install from releases is required; the author notes the software was "vibe coded" and the directory entry is not staff-reviewed.
problem: Obsidian treats each vault in isolation, so there is no built-in way to see which notes are shared or divergent across several vaults or reconcile their differences.
summary: Cross-vault visualizer that renders multiple Obsidian vaults as an interactive graph, highlights shared notes, and diffs/merges conflicting versions side-by-side.
